require 'sinatra'
require 'jwt'
require 'json'
require 'mini_magick'
require 'securerandom'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'redis'
require 'net/http'
require 'uri'
require 'fileutils'
require 'time'

# Kubernetes image processing service
# Deployed as part of media pipeline in k8s cluster
module ImagePipeline
  class AuthConfig
    ISSUER = 'k8s-auth-service.media-pipeline.svc.cluster.local'
    AUDIENCE = 'image-processor'
    
    def self.public_key
      @public_key ||= OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read('/etc/secrets/jwt-public.pem'))
    end
    
    def self.algorithm_whitelist
      ['RS256', 'RS384', 'RS512']
    end
  end

  class TokenVerifier
    attr_reader :config
    
    def initialize(config = AuthConfig)
      @config = config
    end
    
    # Decode and verify JWT token from upstream services
    def verify_token(token)
      return nil if token.nil? || token.empty?
      
      # Extract header to determine algorithm
      header = extract_header(token)
      return nil unless header
      
      algorithm = header['alg']
      
      # Validate algorithm is in our accepted list
      unless acceptable_algorithm?(algorithm)
        log_security_event('invalid_algorithm', algorithm)
        return nil
      end
      
      # Always use RSA public key for verification - never allow symmetric
      verification_key = config.public_key
      
      begin
        decoded = JWT.decode(
          token,
          verification_key,
          true,
          {
            algorithms: config.algorithm_whitelist,
            iss: AuthConfig::ISSUER,
            verify_iss: true,
            aud: AuthConfig::AUDIENCE,
            verify_aud: true
          }
        )
        decoded.first
      rescue JWT::DecodeError => e
        log_security_event('decode_error', e.message)
        nil
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def extract_header(token)
      header_segment = token.split('.').first
      return nil unless header_segment
      JSON.parse(Base64.urlsafe_decode64(header_segment))
    rescue
      nil
    end
    
    def acceptable_algorithm?(algorithm)
      # Only allow RSA algorithms - no symmetric algorithms permitted
      config.algorithm_whitelist.include?(algorithm)
    end
    
    def log_security_event(event_type, details)
      $stderr.puts "[SECURITY] #{Time.now.iso8601} #{event_type}: #{details}"
    end
  end

  class ImageProcessor
    ALLOWED_OPERATIONS = %w[resize crop thumbnail watermark].freeze
    MAX_DIMENSION = 4096
    UPLOAD_DIR = '/tmp/image-pipeline/uploads'
    # Safe ImageMagick geometry: WxH, WxH+X+Y, +X+Y, etc. No leading dashes/options.
    GEOMETRY_PATTERN = /\A\d{0,4}(x\d{0,4})?([+-]\d{1,4}){0,2}[%!<>^]?\z/.freeze
    DEFAULT_GEOMETRY = '100x100+0+0'.freeze
    
    def initialize
      @redis = Redis.new(url: ENV.fetch('REDIS_URL', 'redis://redis.media-pipeline.svc.cluster.local:6379'))
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(UPLOAD_DIR)
    end
    
    def process(params, claims)
      operation = params['operation']
      unless ALLOWED_OPERATIONS.include?(operation)
        return { error: 'Invalid operation', status: 400 }
      end
      
      # Rate limiting per service identity
      service_id = claims['sub']
      return { error: 'Rate limited', status: 429 } if rate_limited?(service_id)
      
      image_url = params['image_url']
      return { error: 'Missing image_url', status: 400 } unless image_url
      
      # Only allow internal k8s URLs
      unless internal_url?(image_url)
        return { error: 'External URLs not permitted', status: 403 }
      end
      
      result = execute_operation(operation, image_url, params)
      { result: result, status: 200 }
    end
    
    private
    
    def rate_limited?(service_id)
      key = "ratelimit:#{service_id}:#{Time.now.to_i / 60}"
      count = @redis.incr(key)
      @redis.expire(key, 120) if count == 1
      count > 100
    end
    
    def internal_url?(url)
      uri = URI.parse(url)
      uri.host&.end_with?('.svc.cluster.local') || uri.host == 'localhost'
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError
      false
    end
    
    def safe_geometry(value)
      geometry = value.to_s
      GEOMETRY_PATTERN.match?(geometry) ? geometry : DEFAULT_GEOMETRY
    end
    
    def execute_operation(operation, image_url, params)
      filename = SecureRandom.hex(16)
      filepath = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, "#{filename}.png")
      
      # Download from internal service
      download_image(image_url, filepath)
      
      image = MiniMagick::Image.open(filepath)
      
      case operation
      when 'resize'
        width = [params.fetch('width', 800).to_i, MAX_DIMENSION].min
        height = [params.fetch('height', 600).to_i, MAX_DIMENSION].min
        image.resize "#{width}x#{height}"
      when 'crop'
        # Validate geometry against a strict pattern to prevent argument injection
        image.crop safe_geometry(params.fetch('geometry', DEFAULT_GEOMETRY))
      when 'thumbnail'
        image.resize '150x150^'
        image.gravity 'center'
        image.extent '150x150'
      when 'watermark'
        # Apply text watermark
        text = params.fetch('text', 'DRAFT')[0..20]
        image.combine_options do |c|
          c.gravity 'SouthEast'
          c.draw "text 10,10 '#{text.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]/, '')}'"
          c.fill 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'
        end
      end
      
      output_path = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, "#{filename}_processed.png")
      image.write(output_path)
      
      # Return internal URL for processed image
      "http://image-store.media-pipeline.svc.cluster.local/processed/#{filename}_processed.png"
    ensure
      File.delete(filepath) if filepath && File.exist?(filepath)
    end
    
    def download_image(url, filepath)
      uri = URI.parse(url)
      Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port) do |http|
        response = http.get(uri.path)
        File.open(filepath, 'wb') { |f| f.write(response.body) }
      end
    end
  end
end

# Sinatra application
set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
set :port, ENV.fetch('PORT', 8080)

before do
  content_type :json
end

post '/api/v1/process' do
  auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
  unless auth_header&.start_with?('Bearer ')
    halt 401, { error: 'Missing authorization' }.to_json
  end
  
  token = auth_header.sub('Bearer ', '')
  verifier = ImagePipeline::TokenVerifier.new
  claims = verifier.verify_token(token)
  
  unless claims
    halt 401, { error: 'Invalid token' }.to_json
  end
  
  # Verify required claims
  unless claims['scope']&.include?('image:process')
    halt 403, { error: 'Insufficient scope' }.to_json
  end
  
  processor = ImagePipeline::ImageProcessor.new
  params = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  result = processor.process(params, claims)
  
  status result[:status]
  result.to_json
end

get '/healthz' do
  { status: 'healthy', service: 'image-processor' }.to_json
end

get '/readyz' do
  # Check dependencies
  begin
    redis = Redis.new(url: ENV.fetch('REDIS_URL', 'redis://redis.media-pipeline.svc.cluster.local:6379'))
    redis.ping
    { status: 'ready' }.to_json
  rescue => e
    status 503
    { status: 'not_ready', error: e.message }.to_json
  end
end
